about.title: About DPD RI KMS
about.subtitle: Knowledge Management System for the Regional Representative Council of Indonesia
about.mission_text: The DPD RI Knowledge Management System is designed to facilitate effective sharing and management of institutional knowledge within the Regional Representative Council of Indonesia. We aim to create a centralized platform that enables members, staff, and stakeholders to access, contribute, and collaborate on important information and insights.
about.mission_text_2: Our commitment is to enhance institutional efficiency, promote transparency, and support better decision-making through organized and accessible knowledge resources.
about.vision_text: To become a leading knowledge management platform that empowers the DPD RI to make informed decisions, foster collaboration, and drive organizational excellence through the effective use of institutional knowledge and best practices.
about.vision_text_2: We envision a future where knowledge is seamlessly shared, easily accessible, and strategically utilized to support the DPD RI's mission of representing the regions and advancing national interests.
about.feature_content_desc: Comprehensive article management with support for text, images, videos, and attachments
about.feature_bilingual_desc: Full support for Indonesian and English languages to reach a wider audience
about.feature_security_desc: Role-based access control and authentication mechanisms to protect sensitive information
about.feature_organization_desc: Category-based organization and powerful search capabilities for easy information discovery
about.feature_accessibility_desc: Light and dark mode support with WCAG compliance for inclusive user experience
about.feature_collaboration_desc: Engagement metrics, likes, comments, and user profiles to foster community interaction
about.dpdri_text: The Regional Representative Council of Indonesia (Dewan Perwakilan Daerah Republik Indonesia - DPD RI) is one of the legislative bodies of Indonesia. It was established through the amendment of the Indonesian Constitution in 1999 and began operations in 2004.
about.dpdri_text_2: The DPD RI consists of representatives from each province, and its primary role is to represent regional interests in the national legislative process. The council focuses on issues related to regional autonomy, inter-regional relations, and the equitable development of regions throughout Indonesia.
about.dpdri_text_3: Through this Knowledge Management System, the DPD RI continues to enhance its operational efficiency and promote transparency in serving the people and advancing the interests of the Indonesian regions.
about.contact_intro: For inquiries about the Knowledge Management System or to provide feedback, please contact us:

userguide.title: User Guide
userguide.subtitle: Everything you need to know to make the most of the KMSetjen DPD RI Knowledge Management System
userguide.step1_desc: Access the system using your credentials. If you don't have an account, contact your administrator.
userguide.step2_desc: Use the search bar on the homepage to find articles by keyword, or browse by categories.
userguide.step3_desc: Click on any article to view its full content, including images, attachments, and videos.
userguide.step4_desc: Like articles, leave comments, and rate the helpfulness of content to help improve the system.
userguide.feature_search_desc: Find relevant knowledge quickly with our advanced search functionality that supports multiple languages.
userguide.feature_browse_desc: Explore knowledge organized in well-structured categories for easy navigation.
userguide.feature_notifications_desc: Stay informed with notifications about new articles and updates in your areas of interest.
userguide.feature_contribute_desc: With editor or admin rights, you can create and share valuable knowledge with the organization.
userguide.feature_download_desc: Save articles and attachments for offline access or share with your team.
userguide.feature_profiles_desc: View contributor information and track article statistics and engagement metrics.
userguide.practice1_desc: When searching, use specific keywords rather than broad terms. For example, search for 'Q3 financial report' instead of just 'report'.
userguide.practice2_desc: Always check the publication date of articles to ensure you're using current information. Older articles may contain outdated data.
userguide.practice3_desc: When creating articles, select the most appropriate category to help others find your content easily.
userguide.practice4_desc: Write clear and concise article titles and summaries. This helps both search engines and human readers quickly understand the content.
userguide.practice5_desc: When relevant, attach supporting files such as spreadsheets, presentations, or PDFs to make your knowledge more complete.
userguide.practice6_desc: When possible, provide content in both Indonesian and English to maximize accessibility for all users.
userguide.faq1_question: How do I search for specific knowledge?
userguide.faq1_answer: You can search using the search bar on the homepage or in the Knowledge section. Type keywords relevant to what you're looking for. You can also use filters like date, category, and author to narrow down results.
userguide.faq2_answer: Yes! Most articles have a download button that allows you to save them in PDF format. Some articles may also have attachments you can download.
userguide.faq3_question: How can I contribute my own knowledge?
userguide.faq3_answer: If you have Editor or Admin privileges, navigate to your Dashboard and click 'Create New Article'. Fill in the form with your knowledge content, add images and attachments if needed, and submit for review.
userguide.faq4_answer: All new articles go through a moderation process. Admins review submitted articles to ensure quality and accuracy before they're published. You'll be notified of the review status.
userguide.faq5_question: How do I change my profile information?
userguide.faq5_answer: Go to your Profile page from the dropdown menu. You can update your personal information, profile picture, and other settings. Click Save to update your changes.
userguide.faq6_question: Can I access the system on mobile devices?
userguide.faq6_answer: Yes, the system is fully responsive and works on tablets and smartphones. Simply access it through your mobile browser.
userguide.faq7_answer: Yes! Click the theme toggle button (usually in the top navigation) to switch between light and dark modes. Your preference is automatically saved.
userguide.faq8_question: What does it mean to 'like' an article?
userguide.faq8_answer: Liking an article helps other users understand which content is most valuable. It also helps the system recommend articles based on popular content.
userguide.tip1: Use filters and sorting options to refine your search results
userguide.tip2: Check article ratings and comments to gauge content quality
userguide.tip3: Subscribe to categories of interest to stay updated
userguide.tip4: Use the browser's Find function (Ctrl+F) to search within long articles
userguide.tip5: Save important articles to your favorites for quick access
userguide.support_text: If you can't find the answer to your question in this guide, please contact our support team.
